concerns.text: FR-001 requires verification of dataset integrity via correct SHA‑256 checksums. T001 lists the checksum for CodeVulnBench as `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`, which is the hash of an empty file, making the verification step impossible and thus weakening the functional requirement.

FR-004 mandates a Negative Binomial regression as the primary statistical test. T008 states that if the variance/mean ratio ≤ 1.5 the pipeline will *fall back to a Poisson GLM*. This fallback replaces the required NB model, constituting a retroactive narrowing of the analysis and violating the specification.

Success Criterion SC-006 (precision ≥ 80 % and recall ≥ 80 %) is not addressed by any task. No verification step checks that the audit‑derived precision and recall meet these thresholds, so the acceptance criterion is effectively dropped.
